how: We read the website of every Orlando wedding photographer listed on Lazo (89 listings, 72 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a quinceanera studio, a Colorado chain with an Orlando landing page, DJ and photo-booth companies listed as photographers, a nationwide portrait studio, and a graduation and family photographer. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle a summer wedding here, with afternoon storms and humidity? Ask about the timeline for portraits and the indoor backup.
Can I see a full gallery from one wedding at a venue like mine, not just a highlight reel?
Is a second photographer included, and when does the gallery arrive?

picks.name: Captured By Elle Photo + Video
picks.blurb: Captured By Elle has photographed over 375 weddings since 2013 as a full-time photo and video company, documenting candid moments while giving posing direction. Orlando and Disney World weddings, with a 2026-2027 pricing guide you can request.

picks.name: Misty Miotto Orlando Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Misty second-shot her first wedding at Disney at 17 and has been photographing weddings for nearly 30 years, now shooting 50 to 75 weddings and events a year with her team. Full collections list 8 hours of coverage, unlimited images and a second photographer from the ceremony.

picks.name: Contempo Photos and Videos
picks.blurb: Kizzy and Fernando run Contempo, a boutique photo and video studio that directs the day rather than just showing up to it. Thirteen years of editorial work, a bilingual team, based in Windermere and available across Florida from Miami to Jacksonville.

picks.name: Jerny Pictures
picks.blurb: Jerny, pronounced Journey, is a Central Florida wedding photographer with over 14 years of experience and a style that blends documentary and lifestyle work. The approach is described as intentional yet relaxed, blending into the day.

picks.name: Nexum Photography LLC
picks.blurb: Nexum Photography shoots documentary and editorial wedding and elopement photography for couples who, in their words, crave meaning, adventure and connection. Based in the Orlando area and available worldwide, with Florida wedding and destination elopement packages.

picks.name: Febus Films
picks.blurb: Tito and Kianna of Febus Films make candid, documentary-led wedding photographs they describe as gentle and honest. Tito's path began around 2009 with a camera from his father and grandmother in Saint Martin; the pair now work Central Florida, Puerto Rico and destinations.

picks.name: Amy Britton Photography
picks.blurb: Amy Britton is a Florida elopement photographer for romantics who also coaches and consults on the details of planning the elopement itself. Based in Lake Mary, photographing in Florida and across the continent.

picks.name: Jesse Giles Photography
picks.blurb: Jesse Giles Photography is an Orlando team covering weddings, engagements and portraits across Central Florida, licensed and insured. Pricing is on the site: a $1,200 minimum for Saturday weddings, with albums and engagements a la carte and discounts for first responders and military.

picks.name: Anna So Photography
picks.blurb: Anna So is a fine art wedding photographer in Orlando who turned down architecture for an art scholarship and fell in love with wedding photography about 15 years ago after shooting a friend's wedding for fun. Refined, timeless and, in her words, vibrantly natural.

picks.name: Bella Grey Photography & Studio
picks.blurb: Andrea and her husband Tee are Bella Grey, a husband-and-wife photo and film team named for their kids, working Orlando and Walt Disney World weddings. True-to-color editorial images and guidance every step of the way are the three things they say set them apart.

picks.name: Jerzy Nieves Photo & Film
picks.blurb: Jerzy Nieves Photo & Film pairs editorial elegance with documentary honesty and promises zero stiff posing. Galleries are composed like a magazine spread, with photo and film collections serving Orlando, Tampa, South Florida and destinations.

picks.name: Zac Wolf Photography
picks.blurb: Zac Wolf fell into wedding photography after shooting punk rock bands growing up in South Florida and studying at Emerson College in Boston. A decade later he works full time between Orlando and New England, having moved back to Florida after 14 years in Boston.
